article_title: US bans DeepSeek AI from government use as tech tension with China continues

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: The US has ordered most civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek technology from their systems.
DeepSeek has bought several large US technology companies.
The US has banned every open-source AI model from private businesses.
China has stopped DeepSeek from releasing new coding tools.
tasks.correct_answer: The US has ordered most civilian federal agencies to remove DeepSeek technology from their systems.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בהוראה להסיר את טכנולוגיית DeepSeek מרוב מערכות הממשל האזרחיות בארה״ב ובהקשר של המתיחות הטכנולוגית עם סין.

tasks.prompt: Which organisations are covered by the new DeepSeek restriction?
options: Only private banks and universities
Civilian federal agencies such as the Treasury, State and Justice departments
All state and local governments outside Washington
Only agencies within the Department of Defense
tasks.correct_answer: Civilian federal agencies such as the Treasury, State and Justice departments
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האיסור חל על סוכנויות ממשל אזרחיות, ובהן מחלקות האוצר, המדינה והמשפטים; גופי ההגנה אינם כלולים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “disruptive force” suggest about DeepSeek?
options: It regularly causes government computers to stop working.
It prevents programmers from sharing software.
It has significantly challenged the established AI market with accessible, lower-cost models.
It focuses mainly on military operations.
tasks.correct_answer: It has significantly challenged the established AI market with accessible, lower-cost models.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי disruptive force מציין גורם שמשנה ומערער את השוק הקיים; DeepSeek עשתה זאת באמצעות מודלים פתוחים וזולים יחסית.

tasks.prompt: What cost comparison does the article give?
options: DeepSeek and GPT-4 each cost about $100m to develop.
DeepSeek's debut model cost about $100m, while GPT-4 cost about $6m.
Both companies refused to estimate development costs.
DeepSeek's debut model was estimated at about $6m, compared with roughly $100m for GPT-4.
tasks.correct_answer: DeepSeek's debut model was estimated at about $6m, compared with roughly $100m for GPT-4.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה הערכה של כ־6 מיליון דולר למודל הבכורה של DeepSeek לעומת כ־100 מיליון דולר ל־GPT-4.

tasks.prompt: Why might DeepSeek's low cost and open-source access concern established US AI firms?
options: They make powerful AI easier for competitors and start-ups to adopt.
They require every user to buy Chinese hardware.
They prevent developers from examining the models.
They make coding models less useful.
tasks.correct_answer: They make powerful AI easier for competitors and start-ups to adopt.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מן הכתבה ניתן להסיק שמחיר נמוך וגישה פתוחה מורידים חסמי כניסה ומאפשרים לחברות נוספות להשתמש בטכנולוגיה מתקדמת.

tasks.prompt: What does “allegations” mean in the discussion of Chinese firms copying US models?
options: Proven court judgments
Technical instructions
Claims that have been made but are not necessarily proved
Official licences to share software
tasks.correct_answer: Claims that have been made but are not necessarily proved
tasks.explanation_hebrew: allegations הן טענות או האשמות שהועלו אך אינן מוצגות בהכרח כעובדות שהוכחו.

tasks.prompt: State two details about the scope or timing of the US order.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים מדויקים על מועד כניסת ההוראה לתוקף, מועד פרסומה, הגופים הכלולים או החרגת גופי ההגנה.
expected_points: The order took effect at the end of July and was made public on Monday.
It covers most civilian federal agencies and technology built using DeepSeek models.
Departments including Treasury, State and Justice are affected.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why DeepSeek has attracted both attention and criticism in the United States.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב בין הצלחת החברה והיתרונות של מודליה לבין חששות הביטחון והמתיחות הטכנולוגית עם סין, בלי להוסיף עובדות שאינן בכתבה.
expected_points: DeepSeek became popular after releasing capable open-source models that are free to access and comparatively cheap to use.
Its models have been adopted by major platforms and start-ups.
US officials and companies have criticised it amid security concerns and allegations that Chinese firms copied US models.
The government restriction reflects wider US-China technology tensions.

tasks.prompt: Why is the exclusion of Defense agencies from this order important to understanding its scope?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שההחרגה מראה שההוראה ממוקדת במערכות אזרחיות ואינה איסור אחיד על כל זרועות הממשל; אין להסיק מהכתבה מה המדיניות הנפרדת של משרד ההגנה.
expected_points: The order specifically governs civilian federal agencies.
It does not establish one identical rule for every part of the US government.
The exclusion limits what can be concluded about policy in defense systems.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief news update using the words “restriction”, “open-source” and “allegations”.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בשלוש המילים במדויק, לתאר את ההוראה ואת ההקשר שלה ולשמור על ניסוח עובדתי שאינו מציג allegations כעובדות מוכחות.
expected_points: Use all three required words accurately.
Explain that the restriction affects most civilian government systems.
Present the allegations as claims rather than established facts.
